value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical highly symmetric nonplanar matching-complex benchmark. Its known five-plus-five homology ranks do not identify the two inequivalent S5 modules, and the A5 degree-two invariant that disappears upon quotienting by S5 gives a mathematically meaningful difference between symmetry quotients. This is a complete finite equivariant classification, not a routine new parameter of an already known table.
